title: Standard-dose versus high-dose prophylactic anticoagulation in critically ill medical patients at risk for thromboprophylaxis failure: a multicentre, parallel-group, double-blind, phase III, randomized controlled trial
official: Standard-dose versus high-dose prophylactic anticoagulation in critically ill medical patients at risk for thromboprophylaxis failure: a multicentre, parallel-group, double-blind, phase III, randomized controlled trial
summary: Primary objective is: to compare the efficacy and safety of HD-PA and SD-PA at Day 28 in terms of the net clinical outcome, which is a composite of venous thrombosis, major bleeding, or mortality
conditions: Intensive care unit (ICU) medical patients with high risk for thromboprophylaxis failure
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age ≥ 18 years
2. Admitted in ICU
3. At least two risk factors for thromboprophylaxis failure among the following: ➢ Body mass index greater than 30 kg/m2 ➢ Augmented renal clearance (renal clearance >130 mL/min/1.73 m2 [14]) ➢ Personal history of cancer (treatment within the past 6 months) ➢ Personal history of venous thrombosis (DVT or PE) ➢ Presence of jJugular or femoral central venous catheter ➢ Ongoing vasopressor therapy ➢ Intubation
4. Signed Informed Consent form (ICF)
5. Inclusion criterion applicable to France only: Affiliated to the French Social Security System
Exclusion criteria:
1. Pregnant and/or lactating women. Serum pregnancy test (for participants of childbearing potential) positive within 3 days prior to randomisation.
2. Participation in another interventional research on anticoagulation
3. Admitted to ICU for more than 72 hours prior to randomisation
4. Postpartum (6 weeks)
5. Weight <50 kg
6. Need for therapeutic anticoagulation
7. Bleeding event related to hemostasis disorders, acute clinically significant bleeding, current gastrointestinal ulcer, or any organic lesion with a high risk for bleeding
8. Platelet count < 50 x 10⁹/L;
9. Recent surgery or major trauma within the past 15 days, or spinal or epidural anesthesia within 24 hours
10. Any prior intracranial hemorrhage, enlarged acute ischemic stroke, known intracranial malformation or neoplasm, acute infectious endocarditis
11. Exclusion criterion applicable to France only: Vulnerable persons according to the article  L.1121-6 of the Public Health Code.
12. Severe renal failure (creatinine clearance <30 mL/min)
13. Hypoxemic COVID-19 pneumonia
14. Hypersensitivity to heparin or its derivatives including low-molecular-weight heparin or to any of the excipients
15. History of type II heparin-induced thrombocytopenia
16. Known hypersensitivity to protamine or any of the excipients
17. Moribund patient or death expected from underlying disease during the current admission
18. Patient deprived of liberty and persons subject to institutional psychiatric care
19. Patient under guardianship or curatorship
